text:
Riley (Sales Eng): Opening a focused thread for AcmeBank POC — objective: validate three MVP flows and confirm acceptance criteria + blockers. Short notes here.
Nina (Solutions): high-level asks from Acme: 1) agent-assist for customer support, 2) nightly reconciliation digest for ops, 3) short-form fraud-alert summaries for analysts. They care about latency on chat and reliability of nightly jobs.
Jared (AE): customer success metric: reduce support average handle time by 25% within pilot. They want a pricing anchor for reserved vs pay-as-you-go by Wed.
Priya (Customer PM): confirmed flows and order: chat assist (highest), reconciliation digest, fraud summaries. They want the demo mid-pilot (end of week 2).
Riley (Sales Eng): suggested endpoints to expose for the POC: `/api/v1/chat/stream` (streaming), `/api/v1/embeddings/bulk` (batching), `/api/v1/score/transactions` (real-time scoring). We'll need per-endpoint SLOs and monitoring.
Nina (Solutions): propose SLOs: chat p95 < 300ms, embeddings batch complete by 04:00 UTC daily, scoring p95 < 400ms. Thoughts? :question:
Leah (Security): quick security checklist: SOC2 evidence, GDPR/EU data residency for two regions, per-tenant KMS/HSM support, data retention controls, and audit logs for 90 days. Also need details on cache eviction and whether any logs include full PII.
Priya (Customer PM): EU residency required for EMEA customers. Audit logs for prompts + responses required for compliance.
Riley (Sales Eng): Action items: Leah to flag any compliance blockers for Private/Dedicated; Jared to provide usage projections so we can model pricing.
Leah (Security): redlines: no unencrypted persistent KV for PII; must support customer-managed keys or isolated tenancy. HSM support needed for production keys. Also need a written threat model for transactional data flows.
Nina (Solutions): on evaluation metrics: customer wants entity extraction precision >= 90% and summarization ROUGE-L >= 0.60 on their labeled corpus. For the reranker/score: expected uplift vs baseline MAP +10%. We'll build evals accordingly.
Riley (Sales Eng): Sam (customer) — can you provide a sample set? Requesting: 150 anonymized chat turns, 600 transaction rows, and 100 labeled fraud alert examples.
Priya (Customer PM): can deliver sanitized samples by Thursday. We'll redact full account numbers but may keep hashed IDs for context.
Jared (AE): budget context: they expect to commit if SLOs met. Preliminary estimate: ~2.5M chat tokens/month, 40k embedding vectors/night, 600k scoring calls/month. I'll push a conservative anchor.
Nina (Solutions): I'll stand up a sandbox harness. Canary config (example):
```
endpoint: /api/v1/chat/stream
model: redwood-2-mini-q4
streaming: true
batching: adaptive
max_tokens: 800
```
Riley (Sales Eng): Nice. Also capture acceptance criteria (minimal pass/fail) so we don't debate later:
- Chat: p95 < 300ms and <1% stream disconnects
- Digest summaries: ROUGE-L >= 0.60 and customer eval F1 >= 0.75
- Scoring/rerank: MAP uplift >= 10% vs their current model
- Ops: nightly embeddings complete within maintenance window >= 99% success
Leah (Security): add security acceptance: encryption in transit & at rest, per-tenant keys, SSO via SAML, audit logs accessible by customer for 90 days, and controls for retention/deletion.
Priya (Customer PM): proposed timeline: week0 (this week) - data + harness, week1 - functional evals, week2 - perf/security review + mid-pilot demo, week3 - final acceptance and contract finalize. Demo requested by end of week2.
Jared (AE): procurement may introduce delays; plan for 1-2 week lag after acceptance. We'll flag to customer.
Riley (Sales Eng): blockers we see: 1) customer insistence on Private control plane could add 3 weeks, 2) HSM onboarding timeline unknown, 3) nightly throughput tuning for embeddings in EU region.
Nina (Solutions): mitigation path: offer dedicated EU tenancy in hosted environment for initial validation, then migrate to Private if needed. This buys time on the HSM and control plane ramp.
Leah (Security): I'll prepare a concise answers doc for their InfoSec questionnaire (SOC2, KMS, retention, breach notification). Need compliance pack from Sales.
Riley (Sales Eng): I'll attach the standard compliance pack and the infra diagram; ping legal for HSM SLA.

Nina (Solutions): created test harness at https://sandbox.redwood.internal/poc-acme/harness (internal) — includes `prompts/` and `evals/` sets.
Riley (Sales Eng): action recap (who/when):
- Priya (Customer PM) -> samples by Thu
- Leah (Security) -> questionnaire draft + blockers by Tue EOD
- Jared (AE) -> usage/anchor numbers by Tue EOD
- Nina (Solutions) -> test harness link + perf config by Mon
Priya (Customer PM): ack, will deliver Thursday.
Jared (AE): will send anchors and conservative commit scenarios Tue.
Leah (Security): will share questionnaire draft Tue and join the demo for security Qs.
